## 🔍 Cross-Page Patterns: Common HTML Issues

These HTML patterns cause the same accessibility errors across multiple pages. **Fix the pattern once in your codebase to fix it everywhere!**

### 🎯 Top Patterns to Fix (Highest Impact)

#### Pattern 1: Affects 43 page(s) - 44 occurrence(s)

**Scanner**: axe
**Rule**: [region](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.14/region?application=playwright)
**Impact**: moderate
**Issue**: All page content should be contained by landmarks

**HTML Pattern**:
```html
<a href="#main-content" class="aegov-skip-content">Skip to content</a>
```

**XPath** (use in browser DevTools):
```
.aegov-skip-content
```

**How to Replicate**:
1. Open any affected page in your browser
2. Press F12 to open DevTools
3. Go to Console tab
4. Run: `$x('.aegov-skip-content')`
5. The element will be highlighted

**Affected Pages**:
- https://designsystem.gov.ae/
- https://designsystem.gov.ae/docs/blocks/accordion
- https://designsystem.gov.ae/docs/blocks/auth
- https://designsystem.gov.ae/docs/blocks/checkbox-radio
- https://designsystem.gov.ae/docs/blocks/content
- *...and 38 more page(s)*

---

#### Pattern 2: Affects 9 page(s) - 9 occurrence(s)

**Scanner**: axe
**Rule**: [landmark-unique](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.14/landmark-unique?application=playwright)
**Impact**: moderate
**Issue**: Landmarks should have a unique role or role/label/title (i.e. accessible name) combination

**HTML Pattern**:
```html
<main id="main-content" class="min-w-0 flex-1">
```

**XPath** (use in browser DevTools):
```
#main-content
```

**How to Replicate**:
1. Open any affected page in your browser
2. Press F12 to open DevTools
3. Go to Console tab
4. Run: `$x('#main-content')`
5. The element will be highlighted

**Affected Pages**:
- https://designsystem.gov.ae/docs/blocks/accordion
- https://designsystem.gov.ae/docs/blocks/auth
- https://designsystem.gov.ae/docs/blocks/checkbox-radio
- https://designsystem.gov.ae/docs/blocks/content
- https://designsystem.gov.ae/docs/blocks/features
